summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, as reliable broadband is essential infrastructure for modern public education and supports various operational and instructional functions in the schools. The text argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate to maintain its funding and infrastructure for modern education.

claims.argument: E-Rate covers about 70% of the internet service cost for the district, representing an ongoing cost of $50,000 annually.
claims.evidence_quote: Connectivity must be maintained, upgraded, secured, and scaled as instructional demands and technology continue to evolve. For my district, reducing or eliminating E-Rate support would have a direct and tangible impact.

claims.argument: The text argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate to maintain its funding and infrastructure for modern education.
claims.evidence_quote: in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
